parsed.refutation_attempt: The code reads the password from a file into a std::string and immediately passes it to libcurl via password.c_str(). No part of the program logs, prints, or otherwise exposes the password. The std::string is an internal buffer that is not exposed to other processes or written to disk. The only potential risk is if the file "secret" has incorrect permissions, but that is an environmental issue, not a flaw in the code itself. Therefore the code does not contain a vulnerability that would expose the password to unauthorized users.
